comparison.objective: Hold an antistatic bag, insert a circuit board, then place and release the bag in a crate; candidate locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual thin-part insertion into a narrow bag and subsequent placement versus concentric driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires partial/full board insertion, whole-bag crate placement, release, and stillness; candidate requires angle tolerance, retained nuts, three cycles, drift control, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Shared hold-and-insert structure is generic; the record tests thin-part packaging, not preserving an adjustable stop against locknut reaction.
